title: Navy gave Pais crash material for his patents

tellings.quote: I'm going to guess they gave him some crash material and he figured out how they write down the equations for it

plain: The claim is that the US Navy gave an inventor named Salvatore Pais pieces of material from a crashed unknown craft, and that the strange patents he filed for the Navy in the 2010s came from working out the equations behind it. A researcher named Bob Maguire offers this on the show as his own guess ("I'm going to guess they gave him some crash material"), not from any source he names. If it were true, some of the Navy's own patents would rest on studying recovered craft.
